guitar.evidence: Steve Howe (ex-Yes) was Asia's guitarist; long associated with his 1964 Gibson ES-175D.
guitar.notes: Well known among prog fans though Asia itself is less guitar-centric than Yes.

tone.summary: A classic 80s stadium rock setup utilizing a Plexi-style amp and Chorus effect to achieve the required bright, chorused crunch tone.

rig.name: Asia - Heat Of The Moment - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise.
Provide the initial crunch and grit needed for rhythm playing.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a mid-range focused boost/overdrive, approximating the Plexi sound without dedicated preamp models.

blocks.purpose: The central element of the tone, providing the signature 80s chorused sheen.
Add aggressive crunch and sustain to the rhythm parts.
blocks.gap: While a dedicated Plexi model would be ideal, RAT-style provides the necessary mid-punch and grit for 80s rock without excessive fuzz.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, mid-focused British rock tone (Plexi/Marshall style).
blocks.gap: The UK 45 is the closest available model to a Plexi or early Marshall sound.

alternatives.model: UK SLP (if more clean headroom was needed)

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British rock cabinet sound.
Slightly boost the mids and highs to enhance clarity and 'sheen'.
Add a polished, natural room ambience without sounding overly wet or distracting.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for a more authentic British rock sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance the authenticity of the Plexi/Marshall tone.
